name: Bank Islam Malaysia Berhad
overview: 2026年，Bank Islam Malaysia Berhad 未在公告中披露任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减或出售事项；已披露的公告主要为季度业绩、董事会委员会成员变动、股东大会及2025财年第二次中期股息的相关安排。
overview_en: In 2026, Bank Islam Malaysia Berhad did not disclose any expansion, new business, reduction, or divestment of business segments in its announcements; the announcements made were mainly quarterly results, changes in nomination and remuneration committee members, general meetings, and the second interim dividend for FY2025.
